episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the ongoing conflict between Compass, Zillow, and MLS over listing data control and its implications for agents. He shares insights into using AI to solve real estate challenges, such as creating an insurance product to guarantee sellers against buyer cancellations. The episode emphasizes the importance of agent advocacy and leveraging technology to stay ahead in the industry.
